metadata.title: Resolutions of orbifold generalised triangle groups
metadata.abstract: Let $T=\langle f,g\mid f^{l}=g^{m}=W^{n}=1\rangle$ be a generalised triangle group in which $W$ is the Farey word of a rational slope $q=r/s$, and suppose that $T$ is the fundamental group of a hyperbolic $3$-orbifold whose singular locus has no spherical vertices. Let $G=\langle f,g\mid f^{l}=g^{m}=W^{n}\rangle$ be the associated central extension. We compute an explicit free resolution of the trivial module over $\mathbb{Z}G$ of minimal length, with differentials given in closed form by Fox derivatives. From this resolution we deduce an explicit free resolution over $\mathbb{Z}T$ which is $2$-periodic in degrees at least two, and we compute the integral homology and cohomology of both groups. Strebel treated the classical family $q=0/1$ in 1983. Since then only the family $q=1/2$ has been treated, by Ellis and Williams, and for that family our resolution over $\mathbb{Z}T$ has strictly smaller rank in every degree.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: 广义三角群的显式自由解消
analysis.workSummary: 对由 Farey 字定义、可实现为特定双曲三维轨形基本群的广义三角群及其中心扩张，构造显式自由解消。中心扩张的解消具有最小长度，微分以 Fox 导数闭式给出；原群的解消在二次及以上为二周期，并据此计算整数同调与上同调。对此前处理的一个斜率族，新解消逐次秩更小。
analysis.breakthrough: 把少数已知斜率族推进到给定几何实现条件下的普遍构造，并改善已有解消的秩。
analysis.limitations: 仅依据官方英文摘要解读，尚未核读数学正文。依赖轨形奇异集无球面顶点及 Farey 字等条件；不能把二周期结论无条件用于所有广义三角群。
analysis.aiEvidence: 第 3 页 AI usage 说明作者此前两年完成初稿时未用 AI，随后使用 OpenAI GPT-6 Astra 校对并发现小的不准确之处；仅记录校对与检查纠错，不归因为研究构思或证明生成。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。第 3 页 AI usage 说明作者此前两年完成初稿时未用 AI，随后使用 OpenAI GPT-6 Astra 校对并发现小的不准确之处；仅记录校对与检查纠错，不归因为研究构思或证明生成。

analysis.priorityReason: 显式微分便于后续同调计算，是几何群论与代数拓扑交界的实用工具。
